assessments.name: Lab Reports
assessments.description: Each of the nine lab reports across the semester is a guided ArcGIS Pro workflow that uses step-by-step instructions and structured questions to teach different spatial analyses and their archaeological applications.

assessments.name: Presentation
assessments.description: Your in-class presentation should focus on the same topic as your final research proposal and be based on a spatial dataset, allowing you to develop, test, and refine your ideas before submitting the written proposal.

assessments.name: Research proposal
assessments.description: This assessment takes the form of a mock research grant proposal focused on a spatial (GIS) dataset, its significance, methods, and archaeological implications.
